Junior Associate Product Manager (Fresher Welcomed)
DevLaunch Labs
Remote (India)

About DevLaunch:
We build productivity and AI workflows for engineering teams worldwide.

Responsibilities:
• Write user stories, track bugs in Jira, and conduct competitor feature teardowns.
• Assist senior product managers in creating PRDs and customer interview transcripts.
• Learn product management fundamentals in a supportive remote environment.

Requirements:
• 0-1 years of experience; freshers and 2025/2026 graduates are welcome to apply!
• Passion for AI tools, tech startups, and product design.
• Good written English and structured problem solving.
• Any Bachelor's degree (B.Tech / BBA / B.Sc).
